summary: Ambev S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K containing its consolidated monthly report under Article 11 of CVM Instruction 44/2021 covering management and related-person securities transactions from September 1-30, 2026. The filing lists insider position balances and trades: the Board of Directors held 30,679,627 common shares with no transactions; management held 3,087,593 common shares initially and ended at 3,027,710 after open-market sales at R$15.75-15.82, plus a securities-lending return at R$15.31; the Fiscal Council held 2,500 shares unchanged. No corporate action, stakeholder solicitation, or strategic event is disclosed.
